lesson_contract.cost_rule: Record exact counts when known; unknown elapsed time remains UNKNOWN.
lesson_contract.enforcement_rule: IMPLEMENTED means a callable tool exists, not that all production paths invoke it. Portable-only tools and manual boundaries remain explicit.

cross_project_relationships.existing_shared_entries: Retained compatibility records. Resolve authoritative runtime decisions in the app root; do not copy new lesson bodies into workstreams.
